newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Winfoong sells HK$224 mln office property.
newsitem.headline: Winfoong sells HK$224 mln office property.

text.p: Winfoong International Ltd said on Monday it was in a preliminary agreement to sell an office floor at Nine Queen's Road Central in Hong Kong's Central district to third party Au Wing Kit for HK$224.5 million.
The property concern said a formal agreement would be signed on June 23 and that the deal was expected to be completed on July 25.
The proceeds from the sale will be partly used to repay the existing mortgage on the property, with the rest for future investment, it said.
Winfoong shares were up HK$0.06 to HK$1.15 in late morning.
